newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Access Health started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Access Health started.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co said on Monday analyst Tom Hodapp started coverage on Access Health Inc with a buy rating and a six- to 12-month price target of $35 per share.
-- "Access is the share leader in the rapidly growing demand management service business, with 20 million lives and contracts with 24 Blue Cross plans," the firm said.

-- Hodapp said Access offered a differentiable service which combined proprietary medical algorithms; provider profiling; specialist triage; and disease management of payers, providers and self-insured employers.
-- He estimated Access would earn $0.86 per share in 1997 and $1.15 per share in 1998.

-- "While this is an estimated $200 million market today, we gauge that clinically-oriented demand management is highly scaleable and has potential to be a $5 billion market as it replaces traditional forms of delivery system infrastructure and information distribution," Hodapp said.
-- Hodapp also said he thought the fragmented market share would consolidate.
